title: Iranian media: Iran arrested 46 people allegedly in a network selling Starlink terminals and seized 139 terminals; there are an estimated 50K terminals in Iran (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Iranian media: Iran arrested 46 people allegedly in a network selling Starlink terminals and seized 139 terminals; there are an estimated 50K terminals in Iran — Iranian authorities arrested dozens of people who were allegedly in a network that sold Starlink satellite terminals …
